verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows indirect, programmatic ways to get data out. The App API can 'fetch data', data-out integrations push data to external platforms, and the CLI and MCP server can read workspace data. Nothing shows a dedicated self-serve export of the whole audience in an open format. Missing for 10: explicit self-serve bulk export (e.g. CSV/JSON) of contacts with custom fields, tag/segment membership export, engagement history export, suppression list export, and any hands-on corroboration of a complete audience export.
